chapter_title: Concerning the Three Creations of the Flesh: the o
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶2:**

All these affections that you perceive, and also the remaining living states of mind [GAP-1: dwelling within] the external natural mind, are established according to three modes of spiritual formation [GAP-2: namely these]: some arise from [GAP-3: incomplete or falsely generated] spiritual births that never reach fullness. Others, however, organize themselves into their own proper spiritual form [GAP-4: from within their own quality].

---

**¶3:**

Also, their spiritual sustenance is of thre[GAP-5: e kinds, according to the measure of] wisdom within them, if they are willing to receive [GAP-6: it from influx]. [GAP-7: Some among them] take in interior truths and the good works that proceed from them [GAP-8: as their sustenance]; they receive interior truths and good works. The [GAP-9: others consume] it wholly, and they [GAP-10: manifest within themselves] the three governing spiritual patterns arising from their essential quality and the [GAP-11: conditions of] the period during which they remain in the external natural mind [GAP-12: below]; they are held fast [GAP-13: by what dominates] in their [GAP-14: ruling love]. The Divine Mediator [GAP-15: orders and governs] all spiritual faculties [GAP-16: according to the divine design].

---

**¶4:**

[GAP-17: REVIEW N] it [GAP-18: brought forth], first [GAP-19: the lowest forms of knowing]. Gather them under this general name: rudimentary natural knowledges and elementary cognitions. From this origin were formed the perceptions rooted in falsity and bitterness, the shallow and yielding appearances of truth, the falsities that wound and pierce, and the [GAP-20: barren growths of the natural mind], and all other states that resemble them.

---

**¶5:**

For that intention belongs to the dominant evil loves that consume living affections. Yet these [GAP-21: REVIEW states that were] implanted belong to the order of elementary natural goods and simple external truths, since that is their essential quality. Nevertheless, the intention that descended by influx from the ruling evils — inasmuch as these evils first manifest in good works and natural knowledges and are not yet implanted in the selfhood and the life of the proprium — this intention formed the perceptions that yield sustaining good works, just as the simple external goods they produce are gentle and nourishing.

---

**¶6:**

Again, the intention that descended from those spiritual powers that both consume living affections and also feed upon natural goods and elementary cognitions — this mixed influx formed perceptions that produce nothing that can sustain spiritual life. The works proceeding from them belong neither to genuine good nor to manifest evil, but remain spiritually inert and indifferent.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: “All these animals that you see, and also the rest of the [crea]tures [upon the face] of the earth, confirm them in three likeness[es of form]: some from [the rulers'] abortions. Others, however, form their own selves in their shape [and likeness].

“Also, their nourishment is thre[efold, according to the] light in them, if they shall wish [to receive it]. [Some of them] they eat see[ds and] fr[uit of the trees]; they eat seeds and fruit. The [others eat] it entirely, and they [bear within them] the three archetyp[es] from their nature and the [conditions of] the time when they are on the ea[rth below]; they are seized [by the rulers] in their [desire]. The Ambassador [has arranged] all powers [by his will].

“[Now] it [brought forth], first [the herbs]. Plant them generally to this name: shoots and grass. It formed the bad, bitter trees, the reeds and the thorns and the [thistles] and these others that are like them.

“For that thought belongs to the flesh-eating rulers. Still, these [that were] planted (belong to) grass and gourds, since they are in their essence. Nevertheless, [this t]ho[ugh]t that came down from the rulers, as they are in fruit and grass first and shall not be planted in flesh and blood, it formed the trees that shall give nourishing fru[it], as their gourds are sweet.

“Again, this thou[ght] that came down from the powers that eat m[ea]t and also eat grass and gourds, it has formed the trees that shall not produce any nourishment. Their fruits belong neither to good nor evil.”

fills.explanation: The standard cosmological phrase "creatures upon the face of the earth" corresponds to living states dwelling within the external natural mind, matching the spiritual reading's "dwelling within."
Completing "likenesses of form" specifies that the three likenesses concern modes of formation, matching the spiritual reading's "three modes of spiritual formation."

In Manichaean cosmology, abortions are the misbegotten offspring of the rulers/archons, corresponding to the spiritual reading's "incomplete or falsely generated" spiritual births from external dark powers.
"Shape and likeness" is a standard hendiadys in ancient cosmological texts, corresponding to the spiritual reading's "from within their own quality" — the creature's full self-organized form.
Completing "threefold, according to the light in them" matches the spiritual reading's "three kinds, according to the measure of wisdom within them" — nourishment proportioned to interior light.

The spiritual reading says "if they are willing to receive it from influx," and in the Kephalaia's register of nourishment, "to receive it" naturally expresses willingness to accept spiritual sustenance.
The spiritual reading says "Some among them," introducing the first type in the enumeration of creatures by their nourishment, paralleling "some from" in ¶2.
Completing "fruit of the trees" specifies the source of nourishment for this type, corresponding to the spiritual reading's "as their sustenance" — interior goods proceeding from perceptions (trees).
The spiritual reading says "The others consume," introducing the second type of creature by nourishment, naturally paralleling the "Some of them" that introduced the first type.
The spiritual reading says "manifest within themselves," and "bear within them" is the Kephalaia's natural register for carrying/containing the three archetypes from their essential nature.

The spiritual reading says "conditions of the period," and "the conditions of the time when they are on the earth" expresses the temporal circumstances that, together with their nature, determine the three archetypes.
Completing "earth below" corresponds to the spiritual reading's "external natural mind below" — the lower realm where creatures dwell during their temporal existence.
The spiritual reading says "by what dominates," and in the Kephalaia's Manichaean register, "the rulers" (archons) are the dominating powers that seize and hold creatures fast.
The spiritual reading says "ruling love," which in the Manichaean/Kephalaia register corresponds to "desire" (epithumia) — the dominant craving through which the rulers seize creatures.
The spiritual reading says "orders and governs," and "has arranged" expresses the Ambassador's (Third Messenger's) role of ordering and organizing the cosmic powers in the Kephalaia's register.
The spiritual reading says "according to the divine design," and "by his will" is the Kephalaia's natural-plane expression for the divine determination through which the Ambassador orders all powers.
Confirming the editor's reading: "Now" is a standard discourse transition marker in the Kephalaia, introducing a new section on plant formation after the discussion of animals.
The spiritual reading says "it brought forth," and "brought forth" is the standard cosmogonic verb in the Kephalaia for the production of natural forms from spiritual influx.

The spiritual reading says "the lowest forms of knowing," and "herbs" is the Kephalaia's natural register for the most rudimentary vegetation, which the next sentence then names specifically as "shoots and grass."

The spiritual reading says "barren growths," and "thistles" is the standard pairing with "thorns" in ancient cosmological literature (cf. Genesis 3:18), representing falsities that wound — barren, harmful natural forms.

Confirming the editor's reading: "that were" correctly connects "these" to "planted," forming the relative clause "these that were planted" which the spiritual reading confirms as "states that were implanted."
